fields.summary: [FEATURE] Implement user authentication system with OAuth2 support
fields.description:
We need to implement a comprehensive user authentication system that supports OAuth2. This should include:

1. OAuth2 integration with Google and GitHub
2. JWT token generation and validation
3. Refresh token mechanism
4. User session management
5. Rate limiting for login attempts

Acceptance Criteria:
- Users can log in with Google or GitHub accounts
- JWT tokens are securely generated and validated
- Session expiry is handled gracefully
- Login attempts are rate-limited to prevent brute force attacks
